name: thread settings

regions_read.verdict_on_region: contact name heading the page — names a person, not which page this is (chat, profile or chat settings); it also scrolls away with the content and the top bar stays empty

identifier_found: same thread-settings template as s44: empty top bar, contact name as content
initial_rationale: same thread-settings template as s44: empty top bar, contact name as content

test_cases.precondition: a conversation open (Krishna Bharti) with its name in the top bar
test_cases.action: tap the info (i) icon; scroll the settings page down and back
test_cases.expected_result: a title appears in the top bar on scroll, or the top bar stays empty
test_cases.confirms_if: top bar has only Back and a menu in every scroll state
test_cases.overturns_if: a collapsing top bar shows the contact name or a page title on scroll
test_cases.observed_result: thread settings opened with a back arrow and three-dot menu only; the large "Krishna Bharti" heading scrolled off with the content and the top bar stayed empty while "Actions", "Privacy & support" rows were shown; no title in any state (tested on the Krishna Bharti thread — same template as Marco Peralta's)

deciding_evidence: confirmed on the device: same thread-settings template as s44: empty top bar, contact name as content; template carry from s44 (tested on the Krishna Bharti thread, which is s49's own thread); also a return-transition landing screen (b14, harness relaunch); no confirmed Disappearing View Identifier transition lands here
recommendation: put a title in the empty top bar, e.g. "Chat settings — Krishna Bharti", and keep it when the heading scrolls away
